title: Living State Current Directive slot + tip-align handoff
problem: Living State Current Directive is append-sludge; STATUS:SYNCHRONIZED while handoff SHA lags HEAD.

solution.summary: Enforce fenced Current Directive block; writers replace slot not concat; auto-downgrade to DRIFT when head_sha≠HEAD; emit tip-aligned handoff via existing turn-end/handoff scripts.
steps: Define schema: <!-- CURRENT_DIRECTIVE:START --> ... <!-- CURRENT_DIRECTIVE:END --> single paragraph; history under ## History only.
Add validator script used by tnf protocol gate profile.
Find Living State writers that concat into Current Directive; change to replace-between-markers.
When emitting handoff, set STATUS DRIFT if head_sha≠git rev-parse HEAD; SYNCHRONIZED only when equal.

Autonomous one-shot: run tip-align emit after validator using existing handoff writer (no human confirm when TNF_AGENT autonomous commit rules already allow agent commits — if commit gated, write handoff artifacts only).
verify: tnf state show shows single Current Directive line
After tip-align, handoff head_sha == git rev-parse HEAD OR Living State STATUS:DRIFT

acceptance_probe: No UUID sludge in Current Directive slot; SYNCHRONIZED implies tip match.
